title: Unit tests for a provider appointment calendar
name: Provider calendar tests

locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how these unit tests set up and isolate the state they check? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: The fixture is built in `beforeAll`, so one ProviderCalendar is shared and mutated by every test. "books an open slot" books 9:00 for pt-100, so the last test "allows the first patient to book 9:00" throws SlotUnavailableError when the suite runs in file order, yet passes when run alone (e.g. with .only). Likewise the first test passes only because it runs before any booking. The tests are order-dependent; the setup should use `beforeEach` so each test gets a fresh calendar.

choiceQuestions.prompt: In the "returns a copy" test, why does setting `slot.patientId = null` on the returned object not reopen the 10:00 slot?
choices: Because patientId is readonly on Slot
Because book() returns `{ ...slot }`, a shallow copy separate from the object stored in the map
Because available() re-reads slots from a database
Because the Date key changes after booking
choiceQuestions.explanation: book() mutates the stored slot and returns a spread copy, so changing the copy's patientId leaves the stored slot booked and available() still excludes 10:00. patientId is not readonly, there is no database, and the map key is the unchanged ISO string.

choiceQuestions.prompt: Patient pt-300 holds 9:30. Another caller invokes cancel(nineThirty, "pt-999"). What happens?
choices: The slot is freed, since any cancel on a booked slot frees it
cancel returns true but the slot stays booked
cancel returns false and the slot stays booked for pt-300
choiceQuestions.explanation: cancel() returns false without changing anything when `slot.patientId !== patientId`. It never throws, and it only sets patientId to null and returns true for the matching patient.

choiceQuestions.prompt: openSlot is called for 9:00 with durationMin 60 after pt-100 has already booked the 30-minute 9:00 slot. What is the stored slot's state?
choices: Still 30 minutes and booked by pt-100, because openSlot ignores an existing key
60 minutes and unbooked, because the slot is replaced
60 minutes and still booked by pt-100
Two 9:00 slots exist, one booked and one open
choiceQuestions.explanation: openSlot only inserts when `!this.slots.has(k)`; with the key present, the call is a no-op. The slot is not replaced or updated, and the Map keyed by ISO string cannot hold two entries for the same start.
